tuples.subject: penal_charge_form
tuples.special_circumstance: Fresh loans availed from April 1, 2024 onwards (and for existing loans, switchover applies from June 30, 2024); excludes credit cards, external commercial borrowings, trade credits, structured obligations under product-specific directions, and other foreign currency loans.
tuples.quote: 257. A UCB shall adhere to the following instructions for charging penal charges in respect of all the fresh loans availed from April 1, 2024 onwards. In case of existing loans, the switchover to new penal charges regime shall be applicable from June 30, 2024.
